title: Receipt
description: Tonight's tracklist prints line by line on thermal paper and curls off the roll. Linger to warm the coating grey, pull the end to tear it off against the serrated cutter, and drop it on the pile.
intent: One physical object finished to the edge: a thermal receipt with real curl memory, dot-matrix heat print, a coating that darkens under a warm cursor, and a tear that follows your pull across the cutter teeth.
